title.narrative: SO1: Open up museums particularly community based and communityrun museums to be spaces for dialogue and democratic participation for local communities and indigenous minorities

description.narrative: Outputs4 community museums setup their own mobile exhibitions oTo be finalized August/September 20234 individual local museum policies developed oDecision was made to create one policy line written by Goodman Gwasira and colleague 4 publications published for community museums and exhibitionsoTo be finalized August/September 2023 along with the mobile exhibitionsActivities1.1Needs assessment and resource assessment: developing an interview and research guideline (research grid with data gathering instruments, such as interview, questionnaires etc.) focusing current state of activities, further opportunities, state of objects, state of qualifications and competencies in living and further museums.Assessments were carried out during concept workshop in 2020 and trips to the museums1.2Carrying out participatory research and joint assessments with target groups, facilitated by GI, UNAM and further participantsResearch was carried out during concept workshop in 2020 and trips to the museums1.3Community outreach to 4 local community museums and supporting them in the conceptualization and production process of their mobile exhibitionsCommunity outreach done during concept workshop in 2020, trips to the museums and constant communication. Change made to work with three (3) living museums rather than the original idea of four (4), due to internal conflict in the fourth museum. Conceptualisation of mobile exhibitions complete. Production to be finalized 2023.1.4Conceptualization of a policy line as well as training program with didactic material for local museums based on previous participatory research and the experience from the community outreach programmePolicy Line to be finalized. Training program Complete 1.5Conceptualisation and production of 4 publications for the mobile exhibitionsPublications for the Mobile exhibitions to be finalized.Results/DeliverablesResearch grid for participatory assessment and research report with recommendationsoComplete Concept paper on museum policies (possibly including restitution issue) oHighly politicized topic. The Project cancelled the conference where this subject would have been discussed and thus there is no concept paper.Guideline for mobile exhibitions oComplete 4 Publications (A4 size, 64 pages, each 1 OOO hard copies plus available as digital pdf)oTo be produced

Change made to work with three (3) living museums rather than the original idea of four (4), due to internal conflict in the fourth museum. Conceptualisation of mobile exhibitions complete. Production to be finalized 2023.1.4Conceptualization of a policy line as well as training program with didactic material for local museums based on previous participatory research and the experience from the community outreach programmePolicy Line to be finalized. Training program Complete 1.5Conceptualisation and production of 4 publications for the mobile exhibitionsPublications for the Mobile exhibitions to be finalized.Results/DeliverablesResearch grid for participatory assessment and research report with recommendationsoComplete Concept paper on museum policies (possibly including restitution issue) oHighly politicized topic. The Project cancelled the conference where this subject would have been discussed and thus there is no concept paper.Guideline for mobile exhibitions oComplete 4 Publications (A4 size, 64 pages, each 1 OOO hard copies plus available as digital pdf)oTo be produced
